Answer ID: 11912 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 653/653=M/1430) There is no verse of the Quran necessary to be recited while performing wudhu . The duas proved at the time of wudhu contain some Quranic duas as well; it is only mustahab (desirable) to recite them. But, reciting them in impure places is makrooh (undesirable) . So, in toilets where the effect of impurity is seen or felt like bad smell, it is better to leave recitation of duas at such places. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
